name: Autobute: Auto Image Attribute & Bulk Updater
author: Digital Web Tutor

sections.description:
“Autobute: Auto Image Attribute & Bulk Updater” is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to enhance your website’s image SEO and accessibility. By automatically populating the Title, Alt Text, Caption, and Description fields of uploaded images with cleaned filenames, it ensures your images are optimized for search engines like Google, driving more traffic to your site. Proper image attributes also improve accessibility for screen readers, making your content inclusive.

Why Choose Autobute for Image SEO?

  • Search Engine Optimization: Automatically sets SEO-friendly Alt Text, Title, and Caption, critical for image search rankings.
  • Time-Saving Automation: Eliminates manual entry of image metadata, streamlining your workflow.
  • Customizable Cleaning: Tailor filename processing to create descriptive, keyword-rich attributes.
  • Accessibility Boost: Enhances image descriptions for better user experience and compliance with accessibility standards.
  • Bulk Updater: Updates existing images, always setting Titles (if enabled) and updating blank Alt Text/Captions.

By default, Autobute sets Title, Alt Text, and Caption for new uploads, with the option to enable Description. It cleans filenames by replacing hyphens with spaces, removing trailing numbers (e.g., “-1”), and capitalizing words for readability (e.g., “flower-in-garden-1.jpg” becomes “Flower In Garden”). The Bulk Updater applies these settings to existing images, updating all Titles (if enabled) and blank Alt Text/Captions, with a test option that provides a link to the image’s admin edit page for verification.

Developed by Digital Web Tutor.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file (autobute-auto-image-attribute-v10-final.zip) and click “Install Now.”
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. On the Plugins page, click “Settings” under “Autobute: Auto Image Attribute & Bulk Updater” to configure options for optimal image SEO, or click “Bulk Updater” to update existing images.
sections.faq:
How does Autobute improve image SEO?

Autobute automatically sets keyword-rich Title, Alt Text, and Caption based on cleaned filenames, which search engines use to index and rank images. This increases your site’s visibility in image search results.

Which attributes can I set automatically?

You can enable/disable setting the Title, Alt Text, Caption, and Description. By default, Title, Alt Text, and Caption are enabled for maximum SEO benefit.

How does filename cleaning work?

The plugin replaces hyphens with spaces, removes trailing duplicate numbers (e.g., “-1”), and allows you to remove numbers, full stops, brackets, or custom characters. You can also capitalize each word for better readability.

Does it support non-English filenames?

Yes, it preserves Unicode characters, ensuring compatibility with languages like Bengali and Hindi.

Can I change the default settings?

Yes, all settings are customizable via the “Autobute Settings” page, including defaults like Title, Alt Text, Caption, and filename filters.

What is the Autobute Bulk Updater?

The Bulk Updater (under “Settings” > “Autobute Bulk Updater” or via the “Bulk Updater” link on the Plugins page) updates existing images, always setting Titles (if enabled) and updating blank Alt Text or Caption fields using your Autobute settings. The test option updates one random image and provides a link to its admin edit page for verification.

Is it safe to run the Bulk Updater?

The Bulk Updater modifies image attributes, including all Titles if enabled, so you should back up your website before running it. Use the “Test Bulk Updater” option to preview changes on a single image.

How can I support the plugin’s development?

If you find Autobute valuable, consider supporting its development by buying us a coffee.
